subject: Next steps — streaming concurrency & test window for BlueHarbor run
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Simmons <alex.simmons@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + asks from today's SLO conversation (streaming + concurrency)

Hi Alex / Samira —

Thanks again for a focused call earlier — I wanted to capture the next steps so we can get your customer-led load window scheduled. Key points from our convo:

- Targets: p95 generation latency <= 150ms for non-streamed responses, and streaming session tail latency (initial response + token churn) under 250ms for the first streamed token.
- Concurrency: you indicated a peak of ~1,200 simultaneous streaming sessions with bursts to 1,500 for short spikes.
- Sustained throughput: target ~250 requests/sec averaged across the window.
- Streams: sessions will stream tokens continuously (average ~50 tokens/sec) and will hold the SSE/websocket connection open for ~45–90s.

Action items I promised:
1) Share a k6 skeleton you can customize to replay streaming behavior and ramp to your concurrency profile. (see attachment: k6_skeleton_template.js)
2) Provide a temporary test API key and IP allowlist ranges for the run.
3) Confirm a 2-hour test window (we recommend a 30m warmup, 60m steady-state, 30m cooldown).

Can you confirm the preferred test date/time (in UTC) and whether you'll run k6 or Locust? Also confirm if you need a replay dataset (you mentioned a 5–10k request sample) or if you'll synthesize traffic.

Attachments: k6_skeleton_template.js (JS)

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

[This message was sent from my Redwood account — if you'd like a calendar invite for the slot we'll create it once I get your preferred time]
From: Alex Simmons <alex.simmons@blueharbor.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@blueharbor.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap + asks from today's SLO conversation (streaming + concurrency)

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the clear summary. Confirming details from our side:

- We'll run k6 for initial ramp + steady-state. If we see artifacts we'll run a follow-up Locust scenario that exercises longer-lived sessions.
- We'll target the 2-hour window on Mon, 2026-10-26 14:00–16:00 UTC (our engineers are available then).
- We'll use a synthesized payload set for the first run (roughly 8k unique requests).
- Primary targets: p95 <= 150ms non-stream / streaming initial token <= 250ms; sustain 250 req/s, concurrency peak 1.5k.

I'll upload our k6 wrapper and Locust scenarios to the Drive folder and share the link (should be done by EOD today). For allowlist, we prefer adding the Redwood test IPs to our firewall — can you confirm what ranges you will use? Also please send the temp test API key and expiration.

Drive link (incoming): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bBlueHarborTestScripts

—Alex

Thanks — see you in the run.
